title: Credential Handling
learning_outcomes: Describe the purpose of Credential Handling and define its core vocabulary.
Apply credential handling in a small PowerShell example and predict its result.
Identify one relevant edge case, version constraint, or troubleshooting step.

content.intro: This lesson covers Credential Handling in the PowerShell learning path. It expands the supplied syllabus heading into an actionable draft with a visual, a worked example, and a short knowledge check.
content.why_it_matters: Secure automation begins by validating untrusted values and limiting the authority of the process. Do not put real secrets in source code or output; use approved identity and secret-store patterns, prefer least privilege, make administrative changes previewable, and record audit-relevant results.
